description.short: Ace Adventures is an outdoor activity provider operating across South Wales, Snowdonia, the Shropshire Hills, and the Cotswolds. Led by experienced instructors, they offer rock climbing, mountain walking, kayaking and canoeing, team building, and a range of qualifications and training courses for groups, families, individuals, and corporate clients.

description.full:
Ace Adventures offers outdoor experiences led by instructors with years of experience and a stated passion for the outdoors. Operating across multiple UK regions including the Brecon Beacons and Snowdonia, they cater to groups, families, individuals, stag and hen parties, fundraising events, and corporate clients, with customisable activity packages and structured training courses.

Activities include indoor and outdoor rock climbing, mountain and hill walking, kayaking and canoeing, and team building experiences. Training courses cover first aid and health and safety, map reading and navigation, British Canoeing 1 and 2 Star kayak and canoe qualifications, expedition skills, introduction to rock climbing, and advanced outdoor climbing techniques. The company also offers a 'The Full Works' five-day comprehensive outdoor experience.

The company is based in Bridgnorth, Shropshire and operates in Welsh locations including the Brecon Beacons and Snowdonia National Park.
